rule: Equal-semantic comparison members must match exact scope/lineage/generation/tick and supported definition versions. Separate native contexts may coexist as separate rows; no global common generation is required or synthesized.
Each native candidate and expected oracle must name the same boundary/Action/result/mutation semantics; old original PC03 POST_REENTRY cannot silently replace current F03 post-A12.
Source/policy pins and event parent/pre/post/ordinal must match the native prefix; sources added later are unavailable earlier.
Chosen runner and native applicable implementation versions must be exactly pinned and independently supported; historical code hash changes are not requalification.
Every required after_snapshot resolves to its original archive; Snapshot-only cannot prove occurrence/ancestry.
Writer termination before fresh readers, distinct stores/processes where specified, no unlisted hidden inputs, >=3 readers per checkpoint per seed.
PC03 and composite END source choices retain their own authorized roles; E2-D01 reuse requires exact source eligibility, not automatic transfer.
Independent expectation bytes remain comparison-only and do not produce native execution output.
All supported positive/negative states, cases, phase/mutation/invalidation/rejection obligations included; overlapping local checks need explicit coverage proof.
Native codec.SET_FIELDS defines unordered collections. Event/lifecycle chronology, policy rules and un-reclassified ordered inputs stay ordered.
No complete invocation schema declares aggregate runner argument/list order; do not infer order-insensitivity for the matrix itself.
No D01 projection generation yet exists or is specified; bind exact agreed source versions later, rather than inheriting another interface generation.
